races.paceDynamic: Spartan Times, Iolaos Du Mou, and Auntie Maggie will engage early, creating a genuine gallop from the start with three confirmed front-runners committed to making the running. This strong pace will stretch the field and test stamina over the 2-mile trip at Uttoxeter. The sustained tempo will set up the race perfectly for hold-up horses who can stay on strongly, while the pace-setters face the dual challenge of fighting each other early and finding extra late. This race shape clearly favours hold-up horses and strong finishers who can capitalize on a strong gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the three front-runners create genuine pace as expected
scenarios.body: The strong gallop will find out the early leaders and set up a finish for horses tracking from behind. Quality hold-up performers like Kalkaroo, Desert Halo, and Diesel Line are perfectly positioned to strike.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front-runner survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders gets an easy time despite the numbers
scenarios.body: Spartan Times or Iolaos Du Mou could pinch a few lengths turning for home if they avoid a speed duel. The pace scenario still favours them getting caught late by closers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent tracker strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Little Soiree and Ten Ten Twenty position perfectly behind the leaders
scenarios.body: These prominent runners can avoid the early pace battle while staying close enough to pounce. They'll have first run on the hold-up horses if the pace is just moderate.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runners go too slow despite their numbers
scenarios.body: An unexpectedly steady tempo would compromise the hold-up horses' finishing kicks. The race becomes more tactical and could suit horses with tactical speed.

watchPoints.text: Watch the early pace between Spartan Times, Iolaos Du Mou, and Auntie Maggie - if they go too fast they'll set it up perfectly for the closers
Monitor Westerton's fitness after 502 days off the track, any market confidence would be significant
Observe Kalkaroo's positioning early as he's the logical beneficiary of the expected strong gallop
Check if Desert Halo travels well into the race given his recent winning form and suitability to the pace shape
Watch for any early moves from Little Soiree or Ten Ten Twenty if they try to steal a march on the hold-up brigade

races.paceDynamic: Not At That Price will take the field along as the sole confirmed front runner, setting a measured tempo without pressure from fellow leaders. Barry Fife and Noble Don will track prominently in second and third, while the majority of the field including Trigg, Lexington Wood, and the three other hold-up horses settle towards the rear. This creates a classic front-to-back shape with a sustainable early gallop that will quicken approaching the final flight. The lack of pace pressure early favours hold-up horses who can capitalise on the acceleration, particularly those with proven finishing kicks like Trigg and Lexington Wood.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace stays moderate and the race develops a strong finishing kick from the back
scenarios.body: The patient riders can unleash their mounts' superior class and finishing speed when it matters most. Trigg and Lexington Wood are perfectly positioned to exploit this tactical scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front runner capitalises
scenarios.trigger: If Not At That Price faces minimal pressure and dictates terms throughout
scenarios.body: The leader can control the race at his own rhythm and prove difficult to peg back despite his modest recent form. Barry Fife tracking prominently also benefits from controlled fractions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent trackers strike
scenarios.trigger: If Barry Fife and Noble Don can improve their finishing positions from close attendance
scenarios.body: The prominent pair avoid the traffic issues that could hinder back markers while maintaining striking distance. Barry Fife's superior class rating gives him the edge in this tactical battle.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If Not At That Price goes too slow and the race becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The entire field converges in a bunched finish where any horse can win regardless of rating. Form and fitness become less relevant in a lottery-style conclusion.

watchPoints.text: Not At That Price must be watched closely for early over-racing given his front-running style and long absence
Trigg's jumping under pressure as he transitions from his patient hold-up position to challenging mode
Barry Fife's ability to maintain his prominent position turning for home without being headed by the leader
Lexington Wood getting a clear run from the back given the bunched nature of the hold-up contingent
Pic N Mix showing any signs of ring-rustiness early given the extended 149-day layoff

races.paceDynamic: Tap Tap Shamie and Final Surprise will dispute the early lead, with both having confirmed front-running tendencies and the pace likely to be genuine from the start. On The Bayou sits prominently to track the leaders while the hold-up horses Evening Tess and Annual Invitation will require the pace to collapse late. The sustained gallop over 2 miles on good ground should set up perfectly for horses that can travel well in behind and finish strongly. This race shape clearly favours prominent trackers and hold-up horses who can capitalise on the expected pace duel up front.

scenarios.label: C

scenarios.trigger: If Tap Tap Shamie can dictate terms without Final Surprise applying serious pressure
scenarios.body: Sean Bowen can control the tempo and kick clear before the closers get organised, with the 6-year-old's proven stamina holding off late challenges. His recent 126 RPR suggests he has the ability to sustain the effort.

scenarios.title: Maiden Breakthrough
scenarios.trigger: If the exposed horses fail and one of the lightly-raced runners finds significant improvement
scenarios.body: Chedworth Boy or Kingofthefrontier could have untapped potential that trumps the form horses, with Fergal O'Brien's stable in good form. The unknown quantities represent the value in a competitive maiden.

races.paceDynamic: Cruz Control will set the tempo from the front with little early pressure, as the field lacks natural pace angles with most runners preferring prominent or hold-up positions. Bhaloo, Calimystic, Party Vibes and Miralago will track in the second rank, while the hold-up brigade of Capodanno, Horantzau d'Airy, King's Threshold, Joyeux Machin and Peaky Boy settle towards the rear. This creates a moderate gallop that will quicken significantly from the home turn as the prominent trackers mount their challenge and the back markers launch their finishing kicks. The lack of early pace pressure favours hold-up horses who can unleash late runs, particularly those with proven finishing speed over this trip.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Cruz Control sets only a steady pace and the prominent horses fail to inject serious tempo
scenarios.body: The moderate gallop allows the back markers to close dramatically in the straight, with their superior finishing kicks proving decisive. Horses like King's Threshold and Joyeux Machin, both proven over course and distance, benefit most from this tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent trackers strike
scenarios.trigger: If the Henderson pair Bhaloo and Calimystic apply serious pressure from halfway and sustain their challenge
scenarios.body: The increased tempo from the prominent horses stretches the field and prevents the hold-up horses from closing effectively. Calimystic's recent winning form and Bhaloo's class advantage become telling factors in a strongly-run finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front runner stays on
scenarios.trigger: If Cruz Control maintains a steady tempo and his stamina reserves prove superior late on
scenarios.body: The lack of sustained pressure allows the leader to kick clear approaching the last fence and hold on grimly. His recent Uttoxeter experience and proven stamina over this trip become decisive advantages in a tactical affair.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapse sprint
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is pedestrian and multiple horses arrive together at the last fence
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where class and recent form matter most, with the fresher horses having crucial advantages. Calimystic's winning momentum and Bhaloo's superior rating prove decisive in a bunched finish.

King's Threshold has strong course record and could be overlooked despite solid recent Uttoxeter win
Bhaloo needs watching in market after long absence as Henderson runners often improve significantly for racing
Party Vibes represents value if race becomes truly-run affair that suits his prominent style

races.paceDynamic: Butchers Bill looks the sole confirmed pace-setter in this field, likely to get an uncontested lead with Ultra Viers, Cher Monsieur, Jo Arengeot Bey and Tom Desjy sitting prominent but not pressuring early. The lack of genuine pace pressure means Butchers Bill can dictate at his own rhythm over this stamina-testing 3m trip. With most runners adopting hold-up tactics including Choice Runner, Warner's Cross, Rule Me In and Crac De Megaudais, the race sets up perfectly for prominent runners who can sit close enough to the pace without having to come from too far back over this extended distance.

scenarios.label: A

scenarios.trigger: If Butchers Bill gets the soft lead he's likely to receive and stays on strongly
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows him to conserve energy for a strong finish, while hold-up horses face the difficulty of making up significant ground over 3m. His similar going record of 6/10 with one place suggests he handles these conditions adequately.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners can sit close enough to Butchers Bill and outstay him
scenarios.body: Ultra Viers or Cher Monsieur benefit from tracking the leader without having to make the running themselves, then having enough left to pass the tiring front runner. Their tactical position gives them first run on the weakening leader.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Strong Closer Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace proves too slow and allows a strong closer to sweep past
scenarios.body: Choice Runner or Warner's Cross use their class advantage to overcome the tactical disadvantage of racing from behind. The extended distance plays to their stamina strengths if connections time their runs perfectly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Weak Pace Causes Upset
scenarios.trigger: If the pace completely collapses and turns into a sprint finish
scenarios.body: A lightly-weighted runner like Stonegate or Jo Arengeot Bey could benefit from the lack of early pace sapping their stamina reserves. The race becomes more about who has the most left rather than who can close the strongest.

races.paceDynamic: Pony Soprano will be the confirmed pace-setter with several prominent runners (Doyouknowwhatimean, Ski Lodge, Nickelforce, Grand Clermont) tracking close behind, creating a competitive early gallop. The substantial hold-up contingent including Ukantango, Tune In A Box, Start Again and Jet Smart will settle towards the rear, relying on the pace to collapse. With multiple prominent runners likely to pressure Pony Soprano and each other for position, this sets up perfectly for the patient hold-up horses to sweep past a weakening pace in the closing stages. This race shape strongly favours hold-up performers who can capitalize on the anticipated pace collapse.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners engage in pace pressure from halfway
scenarios.body: The early gallop becomes unsustainable as Pony Soprano, Doyouknowwhatimean, and Ski Lodge battle for control. Patient hold-up horses like Ukantango and Tune In A Box time their challenges perfectly to sweep past tired leaders.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If one prominent runner can secure an ideal tracking position without engaging early
scenarios.body: A horse like Nickelforce or Grand Clermont sits quietly behind the pace battle, avoiding the early pressure while maintaining striking distance. They kick clear as both pace-setters and hold-up horses struggle with their respective tactics.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace-Setter Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Pony Soprano can dictate fractions without serious early pressure
scenarios.body: The front-runner establishes comfortable splits while the prominent trackers fail to apply meaningful pressure early. Pony Soprano maintains enough energy to repel the late challenges from hold-up horses who find insufficient pace to close.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If the race becomes a complete tactical mess with stop-start fractions
scenarios.body: The established pace and hold-up horses all compromise their chances through poor positioning or tactics. An outsider like Start Again or Jet Smart capitalizes on the chaos with better race-reading from their jockeys.

watchPoints.text: Pony Soprano's jumping early on - any mistakes will compromise his front-running tactics and open up the race
How aggressively the prominent runners (Doyouknowwhatimean, Ski Lodge, Nickelforce) track the pace-setter through the first mile
Ukantango's position turning for home - if he's traveling smoothly in rear, he becomes very dangerous
Amateur jockeys Benjamin Macey and Charlie Case getting outmaneuvered tactically by professional riders
Start Again and Jet Smart overcoming their lengthy layoffs - both need to show early signs of race fitness
